tools.name: search_facts
tools.description: Searches the approved, current facts about Magenta Private Island, a luxury all-inclusive private island resort off Placencia, Belize: villas and suites, rates, inclusions, dining and drinks, activities, getting there, families, deposits and cancellation. Returns matching facts in guest-ready wordin

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Returns the current booking policy facts on one subject: deposit, balance, cancellation, minimum stay, check-in, children, gratuity, payment, whole-island terms, holiday dates or smoking.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Lists the fact topics and how many facts each holds, with the date and fingerprint of the published fact set.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Searches the text of magentaprivateisland.com pages and articles, including the FAQ, the island guides and the side-by-side comparisons with other Belize private islands (Cayo Espanto, Coco Plum, Gladden, Kanu, Bullock, Royal Belize, Thatch Caye, Turneffe). Returns passages with their page title, se

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Live availability and prices for specific dates from the resort's booking system: which villas, suites or the whole island are open, the average nightly rate and the total before tax and fees, plus a booking link with the dates filled in. Unit counts are not shown.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Returns the resort's booking page with the dates filled in, where the traveler chooses a villa or suite and pays securely. No reservation is made by this tool.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Sends the traveler's name, email and question to the Magenta reservations team, who reply by email. For whole-island stays, weddings, groups, special requests or anything else. Requires the traveler's agreement to share these details (traveler_agreed). Never include payment card numbers.

tools.name: how_to_book
tools.description: Returns the booking page for live availability and reservations, and the phone number and email of the reservations team for exact totals, whole-island stays and other questions.
